author: tedcruz
text:
These midterms are the most consequential of our lifetime.

The left is going to turn out. They’re angry, they’re radical, they’re extreme, and they’re unified by hatred for Donald Trump.

We need conservatives, libertarians, moderates, and ordinary commonsense Americans to show up. If we show up and unify, we can grow our majorities in both the House and Senate.

It’s all about turnout.
